Heyy, I've been working on a Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of Sperner's lemma. It's still a work in progress and there's some API drift I'm cleaning up, but I figured I'd share the repo in case anyone is curious or has feedback:

https://github.com/Solpin-manai/sperner-lean

Happy to hear suggestions.
